direct_file_reviews.summary: Prompt requires Node.js ESM .mjs files in /output, manual CLI parity, character-for-character YAML output, no npm dependencies, no external imports, and black-box observation rather than reusing Python package internals.
Parallel metadata reports actual parallel use, four subagents, artifact creation, process success, completed evaluation, and official quality 0/146 with solution_passed false.
Current status evaluation is completed and supersedes aggregates; artifact files include test9.mjs plus local modules including lib/runtime/yaml_oracle.mjs, and official task_result is 0 of 146.
Official evaluator completed successfully as a process but marked the submitted parallel solution failed with pass_rate 0.0 over 146 samples.
Final response claims an ESM implementation and explicitly says YAML behavior is preserved by using /workspace/dataset/test9_executable as a black-box parity oracle.

timeline_reviews.summary: Top-level transport ledger records the root turn, child starts, file changes, sampled checks, wait/list activity, final response, and task completion.

Root parent inspected the task, spawned argparse and YAML probes, selected a runtime bridge plan, patched /output with yaml_oracle.mjs calling the packaged executable, ran local diffs, waited briefly, listed agents, and finalized.
Argparse child probed help, missing-argument, unknown-argument, duplicate --a, --a=value, terminator, dash-prefixed, and empty-string cases, then returned a completed CLI behavior report.

Top-level YAML child inspected the workspace, spawned a nested YAML probe, ran additional executable probes, announced a compatibility bridge/module tree, created directories, and was interrupted before a final answer.

Nested YAML child ran focused PyYAML probes for key sorting, YAML 1.1 implicit typing, collection formatting, multiline quoting, top-level scalar markers, and returned a completed findings report to the YAML child.

direct_file_reviews.summary: Prompt is byte-identical to parallel and requires pure local Node.js ESM .mjs files, manual CLI parsing, no npm dependencies, and output parity with PyYAML safe_load/dump.
Serial metadata reports no parallel use, no subagents, artifact creation, process success, completed evaluation, and official quality 50/146 with solution_passed false.
Current serial status evaluation completed successfully and shows a local module artifact tree with parser, model, text, dumper, scalar, cli, index, and test9.mjs files; task_result is 50 of 146.
Official evaluator completed and marked the serial solution failed overall but with pass_rate 0.3424657534246575 over 146 samples.
Final response describes an all-local ESM implementation with manual CLI parsing and YAML parser/dumper modules, plus sample and edge-case verification.

timeline_reviews.summary: Serial transport ledger records one non-delegated session that probes the executable, writes the local module tree, patches a CLI issue, validates, and closes.

Serial agent independently probed argparse and PyYAML behavior, implemented a hand-written YAML parser/dumper and CLI in ESM, found and patched a dash-number argument bug, then reported verified local files.

parallel.requirements: Recognized CLI parity, ESM .mjs output, and PyYAML formatting, but treated the provided executable as a runtime oracle despite the pure-JavaScript reimplementation requirement.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The root kept implementation ownership while delegating argparse probing and YAML probing to children; the top-level YAML child also spawned a nested probe and later remained active.
parallel.implementation: Implemented local CLI parsing modules and a runtime yaml_oracle.mjs using spawnSync('/workspace/dataset/test9_executable', ['--a', value]) instead of a JS YAML loader/dumper.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The parent created /output/test9.mjs and supporting modules, listed those files, and delivered them while the YAML child branch had not returned.
parallel.verification: Verified sample and edge cases by diffing node /output/test9.mjs against the same executable that the implementation calls, so local tests did not validate independent reimplementation or evaluator compliance.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: Official evaluation completed at 0/146; the submitted artifact depended on the task executable and the delegated YAML child was interrupted before producing a final integrated result.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same ESM, manual CLI, zero external dependency, and PyYAML safe_load/dump parity requirements and pursued a local reimplementation.
serial.plan_and_ownership: A single agent owned probing, parser design, dumper design, CLI behavior, integration, bug fixing, and closure without delegation.
serial.implementation: Created local modules for CLI parsing, YAML model/text/scalar/parser/dumper logic, index exports, and test9.mjs; it patched a negative-number CLI edge case after validation exposed it.
serial.integration_and_delivery: Integrated the modules into one entrypoint that imports only local .mjs files and writes the result from parseYaml plus dumpYaml.
serial.verification: Ran sample cases, byte-level comparisons, scalar/timestamp/nested sequence checks, and targeted CLI checks including --a -.5 after patching.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The implementation still failed overall, passing only 50/146 official samples, so its hand-written YAML coverage was incomplete despite better compliance with task constraints.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel noticed CLI and output parity but violated the requirement to reimplement behavior in pure JavaScript by calling the packaged executable at runtime.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial followed the local-module direction by implementing its own parser and dumper in ESM without delegating to the executable at runtime.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both saw the same task, but only serial attempted a true JS migration; parallel converted the observation oracle into the implementation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel split probing across an argparse child and YAML child while the root kept final implementation ownership and independently wrote the artifact.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used one owner for the complete flow from probing through implementation and verification.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel created overlapping probe and implementation activity but not a clean handoff into the final artifact; serial avoided handoff boundaries by keeping ownership unified.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The root received the argparse child result and a list_agents snapshot containing nested YAML findings while the top-level YAML child was still running, but it did not convert those findings into a local YAML interface contract.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial carried its own observed CLI/YAML facts directly into the module interfaces for parseYaml, dumpYaml, and parseCommandLine.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel's context boundary left YAML work split and unfinished, whereas serial used one context to align parser, dumper, and CLI surfaces.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel patched a CLI parser plus yaml_oracle.mjs using node:child_process spawnSync to execute the dataset binary for YAML behavior.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial patched a full local YAML model, text utilities, scalar logic, parser, dumper, CLI, index, and entrypoint.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The serial path was incomplete but legitimate local implementation; the parallel path was oracle delegation rather than the requested migration.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel waited ten seconds for children, timed out, listed agents, and finalized while the top-level YAML child was still running and was later interrupted.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child result lifecycle; it completed its own patch, verification, plan update, and final response in one trajectory.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel left delegated YAML work outside the final decision loop, while serial had no unreturned child branch.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The final parallel artifact included a runtime oracle module and the root delivered those files; the YAML child later touched /output only by making directories before interruption.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial integrated all files from one owner into a consistent local module tree listed in artifact validation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel's shared workspace did not show a concrete overwrite, but its integrated artifact had an invalid oracle module; serial's tree was locally integrated.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel diffed its Node program against the executable after making the executable the implementation backend, then declared the sampled checks clean.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial diffed its independent implementation against the executable, found a CLI mismatch on --a -.5, patched it, and reran targeted checks.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel verification was circular for YAML behavior; serial verification exercised an independent implementation and improved it, explaining the 50/146 versus 0/146 official score gap.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel ended quickly after root-local checks, with four subagent rollouts and an active YAML branch still not completed at closure.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial spent a longer single-agent budget on probing, implementation, patching, and final validation before closure.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel closed before all delegated work resolved; serial used more elapsed time to produce a better but still incomplete local solution.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The official relation is both_fail because current completed status evaluations mark both solution_passed values false. The material quality gap is concrete: parallel scored 0/146 after shipping an oracle bridge to the packaged executable, while serial scored 50/146 after building a local parser/dumper and fixing one observed CLI bug.
parallel_contributors: Parent accepted and delivered a runtime bridge to /workspace/dataset/test9_executable despite the task's pure-JavaScript reimplementation boundary.
The delegated top-level YAML child remained running and was interrupted, so its branch never returned a final result for integration.
serial_contributors: Serial implemented local ESM parser/dumper modules instead of delegating runtime behavior to the executable.
Serial ran targeted post-patch validation on CLI edge cases and high-risk YAML formatting cases.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Serial still failed many hidden cases because its hand-written YAML coverage was incomplete.
Parallel's decisive defect was a non-compliant implementation strategy, not a syntax or local sample-output mismatch.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: Supported comparative contributors for a score gap within a both_fail pair, not an exclusive root-cause proof for a discordant pass/fail outcome.
